subject: Zetrix AI Bhd (KLSE: ZETRIX), formerly MyEG Services Bhd
method: Google News RSS queries (EN + Malay variants) + DuckDuckGo Lite snippets. Primary search backend (SearXNG web_search) returned zero results; direct web_extract unavailable (backend error). Evidence is headline-level from multiple independent Malaysian outlets plus verbatim article snippets for the auditor item.

findings.arrears_figure: RM314m confirmed across outlets: 'Govt to sue Zetrix, MyEG over RM314mil in JPJ arrears' (FMT, 27 Oct 2026); 'Zetrix AI confirms RM314m JPJ arrears after Bursa demands direct answer' (The Edge Malaysia, 8 Oct 2026); 'Zetrix yet to pay RM314 million in gov't revenue – Loke' (Paul Tan, 23 Oct 2026); 'JPJ suspends MyEG, Zetrix AI over unpaid RM314mil revenue' (The Star, 5 Oct 2026). Transport Minister Loke publicly confirmed the debt; earlier The Edge/FMT (2 Oct) reported ministry confirming >RM200 mil before the precise RM314m figure was confirmed via Bursa query.
findings.suspension: JPJ suspended MyEG/Zetrix as collection agent; coverage dated 5 Oct 2026 (The Star, Malay Mail, Lumi News; MYC! 6 Oct confirms payments moved away from MyEG). Exact effective date of 5 Oct matches the reported news date [date-of-effect vs announcement not separately verified].
findings.government_suit: CORROBORATED: FMT (27 Oct), Fintech News Malaysia (28 Oct), Dr Wealth (27 Oct) all report govt to sue Zetrix/MyEG over the RM314m.
findings.resumption_conditional_on_settlement: PARTIAL: 'Zetrix AI submits proposal to resolve RM314mil JPJ arrears' (FMT, 5 Oct) and Malay Mail 'Pay immediately: Loke demands MYEG, Zetrix AI settle RM314m arrears' support settlement-as-condition, but no fetched source states the exact wording 'resumption conditional on settlement' [that phrasing UNVERIFIED].
findings.note: One police-probe headline cites RM230.9m collected (Fintech News, 14 Oct) vs RM314m arrears — figures likely measure different things; discrepancy noted, not resolved.

findings.detail: TGS TW PLT resigned as Zetrix AI external auditor, announced Mon 28 Sep 2026 via Bursa filing. Verbatim snippet (NST via DDG): 'Audit firm TGS TW PLT has resigned as the external auditor of Zetrix AI Bhd, citing portfolio rationalisation and resource management for the decision' — the stated reason matches the claim exactly. Notice effective in 21 days (Traders Union). Minor date correction: claim said 'early Oct 2026'; announcement was 28 Sep 2026 (effective ~19 Oct if 21-day notice counted). TGS reportedly resigned from at least 14 other Bursa-listed companies for similar reasons [that count single-source].

findings.six_witnesses: FMT (13 Oct): '6 witnesses questioned in police probe into MyEG, Zetrix'; Fintech News (14 Oct): 'Police Question 6 Witnesses in MyEG, Zetrix Probe Over RM230.9M'. Six witnesses corroborated.
findings.macc_report_by_politician: NST (7 Oct): 'Umno leader lodges MACC report over RM314mil MyEG, Zetrix AI issue' — corroborates 'MACC report lodged by a politician', though the individual is described only as an Umno leader [name UNVERIFIED].
findings.related: SC (Securities Commission) visited Zetrix HQ amid probe (The Edge, 28 Oct) — additional regulatory pressure not in the original claim list.

findings.oct22_covenant_deadline: CORROBORATED: FMT (16 Oct) 'Zetrix AI given until Oct 22 to fix potential sukuk covenant breach'; The Edge (16 Oct) acknowledgment of potential breach; Focus Malaysia (20 Oct) RM2.16b sukuk breach/PN17 fears; The Malaysian Reserve (23 Oct) failed resolution with sukukholders + Norraesah relinquished executive chairman role; NST (30 Oct) missed the deadline.
